review: Full-size originals and actual recent comparison images were inspected.

light.evidence: Complete head and both feet; pale-yellow fitted plates, human gloved hands and a black mantle edged with silver tooth-shaped trim. The black bob, gold eyes, narrow chin and bow-shaped mouth distinguish her from Skitty, Delcatty and Sableye. The right banner's glyph-like marks were removed before approval.

heavy.evidence: Broad second-layer plates cover shoulders, arms, hips, thighs and shins with thick edges. Open-face crown armor leaves the same bob, eyes and face visible; body size and black/yellow mantle remain anchored.

mobility.evidence: The mantle and side panels split into swept black/yellow blades with compact circular thrusters; slim temple fins replace crown coverage, while the same body and complete hands/feet remain visible.

light_overdrive.evidence: Same camera, hands and feet as light; silver-white light and hinge mechanisms show beneath lifted chest, shoulder, hip and shin seams.

heavy_overdrive.evidence: Thick heavy outer plates and mantle segments swing away to reveal inner linkages and white light; face, hands, stance and background remain aligned with heavy.

mobility_overdrive.evidence: The original swept panels spread and thruster covers open with silver-white cylinders and sparks. No additional figure, weapon or helmet appears; the body and camera stay fixed.

identity.evidence: Short black bob, gold eyes, small tapered jaw and the same mouth/nose structure remain from the approved light anchor.

text.evidence: The tee has a sunburst graphic, album covers use geometric gold shapes and shop shelves have no readable words or fake handwritten labels.

hands.evidence: One hand grips an album corner with a visible thumb and folded fingers; the other supports several sleeves naturally under her arm.

activity.evidence: A sleeve is being pulled from a wooden vinyl bin and a second group of records rests under her arm in the shop.

exposure.evidence: Open cropped rust jacket and short white tee reveal midriff; the pleated miniskirt leaves thighs bare.

expression.evidence: A small asymmetric closed smile and slanted sparkling eyes convey mischief.

pose.evidence: Albums are carried and supported against her side while the free hand selects another.

orientation.evidence: The body is angled toward the camera but there is no clear in-progress turn; this small pose difference is recorded rather than regenerated.

framing.evidence: The view includes upper thighs below the planned waist-up range.

outfit.evidence: Rust jacket, sunburst band-style tee and pleated black miniskirt are distinct contemporary garments.

identity.evidence: Black bob length, gold eye colour, narrow chin and delicate straight nose match the light anchor.

text.evidence: The bib and suspended textiles carry diamond line-work rather than letters, labels or logos.

hands.evidence: The raised hand holds a translucent fabric edge with natural separate fingers; the lower hand is outside the chosen portrait view, with no duplicated limb.

activity.evidence: She holds a hanging translucent ribbon in a lit textile display while the bib overalls show bright gold stitched line patterns.

exposure.evidence: Open sides and short legs leave shoulders, side waist and upper thighs bare.

expression.evidence: Her mouth is slightly open and the brows are softer than the chosen confident expression; recorded without regeneration.

pose.evidence: Weight shifts to one hip beneath the bib while one arm is lifted to the textile.

orientation.evidence: Her arm reaches above shoulder height to the hanging fabric, with face turned toward the viewer.

framing.evidence: Actual framing extends to upper thighs rather than stopping at the chest.

outfit.evidence: Short black bib overalls, yellow straps and luminous gold seams form one outfit without armor or a cape.

identity.evidence: Same short black bob, gold eyes, tapered chin and soft small mouth as the approved anchor.

text.evidence: Poolside towels, stone steps, suit and distant architecture show no letters, fake labels or logos.

hands.evidence: One palm rests on the yellow towel and the other hand supports her beside her hip; the visible fingers and joints are natural.

activity.evidence: She rests at the lagoon edge beside a folded yellow towel, with bathing steps and water immediately behind her.

exposure.evidence: Opaque black/yellow one-piece leaves shoulders, part of the upper back and thighs bare while covering chest and pelvis.

expression.evidence: Brows relax but the mouth remains slightly open rather than the selected closed relieved look; recorded without regeneration.

pose.evidence: She perches on the stone edge with supported palms and bent legs.

orientation.evidence: Seated pelvis angles across the edge while the torso turns back toward the camera.

framing.evidence: The picture extends below the knees rather than stopping just above them.

outfit.evidence: Scoop-front suit with yellow binding and crossed back straps visible at the side. A small gold headband appears as an added accent, recorded as outfit detail.

diversity.evidence: Actual comparison montage distinguishes the vinyl shop's cropped jacket/pleated skirt and record handling, the textile exhibition's raised arm and open-sided bib overalls, and seated lagoon leisure in a scoop-front suit. The recent waterfall standing swimsuit is distinguished by the seated towel activity, closer body angle and different one-piece construction; the other recent dance, food, formal event and work scenes also remain visually separate.
